semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The laboratory is involved in the theoretical design and realization of quantum computing devices using semiconductor technologies.
summary: Teikyo University's Tanamoto Laboratory focuses on quantum engineering, particularly the design and theoretical realization of quantum annealing machines and quantum computers using semiconductor LSIs. The lab addresses integration challenges of superconducting qubits and semiconductor-based quantum devices, with an emphasis on security technologies for quantum applications.
capabilities: Theoretical realization of quantum computers using semiconductor LSIs
Integration of superconducting qubits with semiconductor devices
Development of electrical circuit models with novel physical elements
